fields.description: +1 to physical actions involving sustained movement, {{ ability:climbing.name }}, or jumping.
+1 when searching for small details, tracks, traps, or hidden objects.
+1 to {{ ability:persuasion.name }} when the character has time to explain their position.
+1 to find shelter, ration supplies, or choose a safe route through hostile wilderness.
+2 to resist exposure to natural heat, cold, wind, or heavy rain during travel.
Attacks are more effective when the target has not detected the character.
+1 to actions based on raw {{ ability:strength.name }}.
+2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} during formal negotiations and political discussions.
+1 when stabilizing injuries or using mundane medical supplies.
Drawing or changing a readied weapon does not slow the character's first action.
+1 when blocking with a shield or protecting an adjacent ally.
+2 when following a trail left by a known creature.
+1 when identifying a RULE, rune, or magical phenomenon.
+1 when repairing, evaluating, or creating mundane equipment.
+1 when fighting a single visible opponent without nearby interference.
+2 when calming or understanding ordinary animals.
+2 to {{ ability:navigation.name }}, rigging, and balance aboard a vessel.
+1 when finding illicit goods, rumors, or safe routes through a city.
+1 to resist fear, {{ ability:intimidation.name }}, and supernatural dread.
The character cannot be frozen by ordinary cold.
+2 to resist poison and identify common toxins by taste or smell.
The character can use either hand with equal precision.
After a successful coordinated attack, the next allied action in the same turn gains +1.
The character can sense whether a touched rune is dormant or active.
+2 when recalling a scene, route, face, or exact spoken detail.
+1 when using an ordinary object for an unintended but plausible purpose.
+1 to actions while at or below 20% of maximum HP.
+1 to Reflexes when reacting to an unseen or unexpected threat.
A successful heavy melee attack produces a stronger positional effect.
Once per session, reroll a failed non-critical utility roll.
Once per scene, an ally who hears the character gains +1 against fear.
+2 to actions made to open or inspect ordinary mechanical locks.
+2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions for quietly entering, crossing, or leaving a secured building.
+1 to ranged weapon attacks against a visible target at least 10 meters away.
+1 to actions involving unarmed fighting or grappling.
+2 when identifying or working with medicinal or poisonous plants.
+2 to {{ ability:intelligence.name }} actions for identifying, preparing, or safely handling alchemical substances.
+2 to actions involving forging, evaluating, or repairing metal weapons, armor, and tools.
+2 to {{ ability:dexterity.name }} actions involving balance, tumbling, or acrobatic movement.
+2 to {{ ability:perception.name }} actions when examining a scene for physical evidence.
+1 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions made to coordinate a willing group under immediate pressure.
+2 to {{ ability:charisma.name }} actions when performing or imitating a person studied in advance.
+2 to {{ ability:intelligence.name }} actions involving historical knowledge.
+2 to actions involving identifying, understanding, or creating runes.
Specialized weapon: {{ weapons.name }}. The character gains +2 to attacks or other relevant actions using that weapon.

Specializes in {{ ability:hunting.name }} {{ creature:monster.generator.name }} and gains +2 to {{ ability:tracking.name }} when following or identifying one, recalling its weaknesses, or preparing to face it.
Studied culture: {{ race.name }}. The character gains +2 to relevant knowledge or social actions involving that race.
+2 to relevant {{ ability:animal_handling.name }}, control, and balance actions while mounted.
+2 to {{ ability:stealth.name }} while moving cautiously rather than rushing.
After observing another character successfully perform an action, gains +1 on the first attempt to reproduce that action during the same scene.
+2 when searching explored locations for useful supplies, components, ammunition, or salvage.
